purpose: factorial decomposition of SPY regime / relative strength / breadth filters; fixed definitions, no threshold search

definitions.A_current: all current Track B trades, LONG+SHORT
definitions.C_spy_only: LONG + prior completed SPY bull regime: >=2/3 of close>EMA50, EMA20>EMA50, 20d return>0
definitions.M_breadth_only: LONG + >=50% of available 53-symbol universe closes above EMA50
definitions.CR_D_spy_rs: LONG + SPY bull regime + stock 20d return >= SPY 20d return (D)
definitions.RM_rs_breadth: LONG + stock 20d return >= SPY 20d return + breadth>=50%, no SPY regime requirement
definitions.CRM_E_spy_rs_breadth: LONG + SPY bull regime + stock 20d return >= SPY 20d return + breadth>=50% (E)

audit.note: Current 53-symbol universe projected backward; survivorship/post-selection bias remains. Breadth threshold fixed at 50%; filters are evaluated using only completed RTH daily bars prior to entry.
